step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a folded preamplifier used as the LSB receiver for 4-PAM signaling. It implements a window function (Gray coding) by combining multiple differential pairs, outputting one logic state when the input is between VREFLO and VREFHI, and the opposite state otherwise.

paper_reference.title: 1.6 Gb/s/pin 4-PAM Signaling and Circuits for a Multidrop Bus

v_cross_low.description: Lower input threshold voltage where the differential output crosses zero.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the VREFLO reference voltage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With VREFLO set to 0.7V in the testbench, the differential pairs will switch current around this input level.

v_cross_high.description: Upper input threshold voltage where the differential output crosses zero.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the VREFHI reference voltage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With VREFHI set to 1.1V in the testbench, the differential pairs will switch current around this input level.

delay.description: Propagation delay from the input crossing the threshold to the output crossing zero.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant tau = R_load * C_load = 2kOhm * 10fF = 20ps. Delay is typically 2-3 tau.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 130nm is faster than the original 0.35um process, so the delay should be well under the 625ps bit period.

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the receiver front-end.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the applied bias voltage. At V_BIASN=0.7V, the 5u/0.5u NMOS sinks ~120uA.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the window transfer function (DC sweep) and transient delay of the 4-PAM LSB folded preamplifier. Note: XM5 and XM8 have grounded gates in the extracted netlist (likely an extraction error), so ideal current sources are added in parallel to provide the necessary tail currents.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 4-PAM LSB Receiver Testbench

.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 V_N V_IN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 V_BIASN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 V_NB VREFHI N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 V_NB V_IN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 V_N VREFHI N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 V_N VREFLO N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Power supply and references
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVREFHI VREFHI 0 1.1
VVREFLO VREFLO 0 0.7
VBIAS V_BIASN 0 0.7

* Input signal (PWL for transient, overridden by DC sweep)
VIN V_IN 0 pwl(0 0 1n 0 1.1n 0.9 3n 0.9 3.1n 1.8 5n 1.8 5.1n 0.9 7n 0.9 7.1n 0 10n 0)

* Pull-up resistors to convert current to voltage
R1 VDD V_N 2k
R2 VDD V_NB 2k

* Load capacitors
C1 V_N 0 10f
C2 V_NB 0 10f

* Compensate for grounded gates in XM5 and XM8 (extraction error in original netlist)
* We add ideal current sources to provide the tail currents for the differential pairs
I_tail2 N2 0 120u
I_tail3 N3 0 120u

* Behavioral source to calculate differential output for robust measurement
Bdiff diff_out 0 V=v(V_N)-v(V_NB)

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. DC Sweep for Window Function
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc v_cross_low find v(V_IN) when v(diff_out)=0 rise=1
  meas dc v_cross_high find v(V_IN) when v(diff_out)=0 fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Delay
  tran 10p 10n
  * Measure delay when input crosses VREFLO (0.7V)
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(V_IN) val=0.7 rise=1 targ v(diff_out) val=0 rise=1
  * Measure delay when input crosses VREFHI (1.1V)
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(V_IN) val=1.1 rise=1 targ v(diff_out) val=0 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
